filesystem.purpose: Repository-scoped file access for reading and editing project files
filesystem.production_restrictions: no production file writes without explicit approval
filesystem.version_update_policy: follow host application MCP filesystem server releases

source-control.production_restrictions: no force-push, no history rewrite, no credential rotation without approval

browser.network_scope: approved domains only (GitHub, npm, PyPI, Docker Hub documentation)
browser.production_restrictions: no production browser access without explicit approval
browser.version_update_policy: follow host application MCP browser server releases
